scope: Generic native-source semantic mapping only. No aircraft, OEM-equivalence, installed-engine, or validation claim.

extraction_policy.scalar_rule: Require exact expected path and 1x1 Data; use the single retained native Data sample. No averaging/interpolation.
extraction_policy.vector_rule: Require exact 1x12 Data and preserve element order. No sorting/relabeling by magnitude.
extraction_policy.finite_rule: All numeric semantic fields required by the contract must be finite unless an explicit per-field exception is added by controlled revision.
extraction_policy.raw_preservation: Semantic outputs are derivative; raw MAT remains authoritative.

warning_policy.source_warning: Warning in AGTF30_eng/Engine/BackEng/CoreNoz, Backflow warning PtIn <= Pamb
warning_policy.assignment_basis: The controlled grid runner executes reference_grid.csv deterministically with for i=1:height(T). The warning occurs during the 15th steady-state IC-generation cycle. The 15th executed grid point is SRC-PP-01. The diary warning itself does not contain a point identifier.
warning_policy.interpretation: Retain as native convergence-path evidence. The accepted final SRC-PP-01 state has S7.Pt > Pa and does not itself demonstrate final-state core-nozzle backflow.
warning_policy.parser_requirement: Preserve a warning/disposition flag in semantic evidence; do not suppress or silently discard the event.

applicability_limits: This contract maps generic AGTF30/T-MATS source semantics only.
No field is OEM-specific engine data or downstream installed-aircraft validation evidence.
FAN source setup includes low-Nc extrapolated map rows for convergence.
HPT source setup includes high-Nc extrapolated map rows for convergence.
LPT source setup includes extrapolated map regions for convergence.
Map-coordinate and stall-margin diagnostics therefore require source-model applicability flags and must not be promoted to OEM operability margins.
Generic source correlation does not by itself validate any downstream aircraft-specific hot-day performance.

markers: ICss(1..5) LP/HP shaft rpm, Wf, VAFN, VBV+1
VAFN and VBV schedule error terms

acceptance_rules_for_semantic_rerun: Exact mapping contract identity and SHA-256 preserved in controlled evidence.
18/18 source points execute and satisfy existing requested-vs-source-actual binding.
18/18 required semantic extractions pass path/shape/finite checks.
Raw MAT is saved before semantic extraction and remains authoritative.
Semantic output contains mapping contract schema/hash and source/harness/run binding.
SRC-PP-01 CoreNoz convergence-path warning is retained and explicitly flagged.
No semantic quantity is silently unit-converted, renamed to an OEM parameter, or used as an aircraft-level result.
Controlled run result is a semantic-deck CANDIDATE requiring Oversight artifact review; automated CI does not self-issue VAL.
revision_basis: VAFN exact source wiring clarified: the same source demand feeds bypass NozVar Ath and Aexit.
CoreNoz warning assignment clarified as deterministic execution-order correlation, not a directly point-labelled warning.
VBV clarified as a source-model demand/position signal, not a measured actuator-state claim.

traceability_policy.claim_rule: Every promoted semantic quantity must trace to exact AGTF30/T-MATS source/model documentation or direct Run #3 native evidence.
traceability_policy.unresolved_rule: Insufficiently defined source fields remain raw-preserved and NOT_PROMOTED_UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_FIELD.
traceability_policy.inference_rule: Inferred associations must be labelled separately from direct source observations.
traceability_policy.raw_authority: Run #3 raw MAT remains authoritative over derivative semantic exports.
